sources.title: Closed-form evaluation of the cumulative distribution function and absolute moments of the variance-gamma distribution
sources.actual_read_scope: Scientific HTML body, introduction, Theorems2.1/2.2, Lemma2.3 proof and Corollaries2.4/2.5 including the two-normal specialization; references inspected.
sources.boundary: Real variance-gamma CDFs and odd absolute moments, including products of two real correlated centered normals and independent sums. Not ordinary holomorphic moments of three complex Gaussian factors, and not an ideal-generation or GMC theorem.

sources.title: A Stein characterisation of the distribution of the product of correlated normal random variables
sources.actual_read_scope: Primary abstract and version history only; not the full13-page source.
sources.boundary: Two correlated real normal factors with nonzero means and sums of independent copies; moment recurrences. No formula imported for the three-factor complex covariance ideal.

additional_search_coverage: Products of three correlated normals, product-normal moment formulas, Stein operators, recent variance-gamma and Gaussian moment papers. Search coverage is not exhaustive bibliographic or priority certification.
new_proof: Internal balanced covariance semigroup, symmetric invariant ring, exact degree-six annihilation and direct dual ideal nonmembership certificates.
assurance: No external review, formal verification or novelty claim. Absolute moments and complex pure Wick moments remain distinct.
